描述_EN: on the top, a small pagoda is flanked by two daoist motifs associated with long life: on one side, an old man with a large forehead and a long beard reprenting shou xing, the star-god of longevity, and on the other side a flying crane. the rest of the mirror is occupied by two rows of young boys in procession surrounded by auspicious symbols, such as coins and peaches. this circular bronze mirror with plain raised rim and hemispherical boss in the centre is decorated on one side with figures and symbols cast in relief.
描述_ZN: 顶部是一座小塔，两侧是两个与长寿有关的道教图案：一边是一个大额头和长胡子的老人，代表寿星，另一边是一只飞翔的仙鹤。 镜子的其余部分由两排小男孩组成的队伍占据，周围是吉祥物，如钱币和桃子。 这面圆形的铜镜有平坦的凸缘，中间有半球形的凸起，一面有浮雕的人物和符号的装饰。
